summary: Queue local connections while the daemon initializes its store

replay.detail: Canonical projection catch-up still completes before requests are accepted.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes or coordinated upgrade requirement.

compatibility.detail: Both Unix listeners bind before store initialization with a requested backlog of 1024. HTTP requests wait until the existing initialization sequence finishes; client deadlines and protocols are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The stop-to-bind window and existing stream disconnects remain. Early binding removes connection refusals during subsequent store initialization, within the kernel backlog and client deadline limits.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration steps required.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state. A failed startup closes its queued connections; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged.
